subject: Security walkthrough — nightblock proposal for SOC2 / DPA / pen-test
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-fin.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-fin.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 23:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough timing — evening options?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Our compliance team is US-based but we also need to bring in two app owners in APAC — we were hoping to book an evening/night block so everyone can join without pushing people to midnight.

High level ask: 90-min walkthrough covering SOC2 controls mapping, DPA questions, and a short pen-test scoping discussion. Can you propose 2 x 90-min options next week (ideally starting between 22:00–23:30 EST) so we can lock internal attendees and the APAC folks?

Also — can you share a short pre-read (10–15 mins) so our reviewers can prep?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Director, Compliance
Acme Financial Services


From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-fin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-fin.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 01:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough timing — evening options?

Hi Aisha — appreciate the context. We can absolutely do a nightblock to accommodate APAC. Proposed 90-min options (all EST):

- Option A: Mon 2025-11-24 22:30–00:00 EST
- Option B: Tue 2025-11-25 23:00–00:30 EST

I'll put a preliminary placeholder on our side for Option A and Option B until you confirm which works best. Attendees from Redwood: me (Security/Controls lead), Kimberly Park (Customer Success / Evidence handoff), Ben Carter (Pen-test coordinator).

Pre-read: attaching a short agenda + evidence index (PDF + XLSX). We'll include a one-page controls mapping and the DPA excerpt relevant to data flows.

Let me know which slot you prefer and whether you want us to include a short live demo of our data flows (10–15 mins) as part of the walkthrough.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_compliance-briefing-agenda.pdf (PDF, 180KB), evidence-index.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Hi Aisha — quick note from our side:

- We can cover SOC2 control mappings and hand off the evidence during the call; Ben will cover pen-test scope.
- If you prefer Option A (Mon 22:30 EST), we can have an engineer on the bridge for the demo and a secondary evidence owner in case anything is requested live.

Action items for Acme: please confirm which option you want and provide the names/emails of the APAC app owners so we can send calendar invites in their local time.

Also, small ask: if there are any specific DPA clauses you want us to call out (data residency, subprocessors), flag them and we'll prepare the excerpt page.

Thanks — I'll keep the placeholders until EOD your time.

Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus/Kimberly — Option A (Mon 22:30 EST) works best for the majority. Please include a calendar invite in IST for our APAC owners: Ramesh Iyer <ramesh.iyer@acme-fin.com> and Mei Lin <mei.lin@acme-fin.com>.

We'd like the pre-read agenda posted to a shared drive and a single page DPA excerpt that highlights delta items (residency, subprocessors). Also please keep the demo to 10 minutes.

Confirming: 2025-11-24 22:30–00:00 EST (90 mins) — attendees from Acme: Aisha Khan, Tom Reynolds, Ramesh Iyer, Mei Lin. Redwood attendees: Markus Klein, Kimberly Park, Ben Carter, one engineer.

I'll approve the slot on the HubSpot event when I receive the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Aisha
